title: AI-Powered Troubleshooting Expansion
summary: Enhance the AI assistant with specialized knowledge modules for VPN connectivity issues, Docker networking problems, Arr service configuration, and Plex/Jellyfin media scanning. Include diagnostic command execution, log analysis, and configuration fix suggestions.

phases.name: Knowledge Modules & Error Pattern Database
phases.description: Create specialized troubleshooting knowledge bases that the AI can reference for common issues

subtasks.title: Create VPN troubleshooting knowledge module
subtasks.description: Build knowledge base for VPN-related issues including 'VPN shows healthy but services can't connect', Gluetun configuration, kill switch problems, and provider-specific issues
subtasks.acceptance: Module exports VPN_TROUBLESHOOTING_KB with issue patterns, diagnostics, and solutions
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive VPN troubleshooting knowledge module with 7 major issue patterns (vpn-healthy-but-no-connection, kill-switch-blocking, auth-failed, dns-leak, port-forwarding-failed, connection-timeout, local-network-unreachable). Includes diagnostic steps, solutions with config examples, search functions, and log pattern matching. Covers Gluetun and major VPN providers (NordVPN, Mullvad, ProtonVPN, Surfshark, PIA).

subtasks.title: Create Docker networking knowledge module
subtasks.description: Build knowledge base for Docker networking issues: container isolation, DNS resolution, port conflicts, network modes, and inter-container communication
subtasks.acceptance: Module exports DOCKER_NETWORKING_KB with common error patterns and solutions
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive Docker networking troubleshooting knowledge module with 11 major issue patterns (container-no-internet, inter-container-dns-failed, port-conflict, network-mode-misconfigured, localhost-not-working, dns-resolution-failed, port-mapping-not-working, bridge-network-mtu-issue, ipv6-connectivity-issue, container-network-isolation). Includes diagnostic steps, solutions with config examples, search functions, and log pattern matching. Covers all common Docker networking scenarios including network modes, DNS, port mapping, inter-container communication, and VPN integration.

subtasks.title: Create Arr service interconnection knowledge module
subtasks.description: Build knowledge base for Sonarr/Radarr/Prowlarr/qBittorrent interconnection issues: API key problems, URL configuration, category mapping, and import failures
subtasks.acceptance: Module exports ARR_INTERCONNECTION_KB covering all common *arr service integration issues
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive Arr interconnection knowledge module with 8 major issue patterns (api-key-invalid, url-connection-failed, download-client-unreachable, prowlarr-sync-failed, category-mapping-failed, import-failed-no-files, test-connection-timeout, indexer-search-failed). Includes diagnostic steps, solutions with config examples, search functions, and log pattern matching. Covers all common *arr stack integration issues including API keys, URL configuration, VPN network modes, category mapping, file permissions, path mapping, and Prowlarr sync. Module exports ARR_INTERCONNECTION_KB and helper functions for searching and filtering issues.

subtasks.title: Create media scanning knowledge module
subtasks.description: Build knowledge base for Plex/Jellyfin media scanning issues: library not updating, file naming conventions, permissions, transcoding problems, and metadata issues
subtasks.acceptance: Module exports MEDIA_SCANNING_KB with patterns for Plex and Jellyfin issues
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive media scanning knowledge module (1,276 lines) with 10 major issue patterns covering Plex/Jellyfin problems: library-not-updating, file-naming-incorrect, permission-denied, transcoding-failed, transcoding-permission-failed, metadata-not-loading, codec-not-supported, plex-claim-failed, jellyfin-reverse-proxy. Includes diagnostic steps with docker commands, solutions with config examples, search functions, and log pattern matching. Covers file permissions (PUID/PGID), volume mounts, naming conventions, transcoding setup (hardware acceleration, tmpfs, FFmpeg), metadata agents, and reverse proxy configuration. Helper functions for searching and filtering by server/media type/severity. Commit: dd23b37

subtasks.title: Create common error patterns database
subtasks.description: Build a comprehensive error pattern database that maps log messages to known issues and solutions across all services
subtasks.acceptance: Module exports ERROR_PATTERNS with regex patterns, severity levels, and suggested fixes
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive error pattern database (1,194 lines) with 30+ error patterns covering all service categories. Includes VPN (5 patterns), Docker networking (6 patterns), Arr stack (6 patterns), media servers (6 patterns), download clients (2 patterns), and general errors (5 patterns). Each pattern includes regex matching, severity levels, common causes, quick fixes, and references to detailed knowledge base modules. Helper functions provided: matchErrorPatterns() for log analysis, searchErrorPatterns() for keyword search, analyzeLogOutput() for comprehensive analysis with grouping and summary generation. Supports filtering by category, severity, and service name. Commit: 93ae474

subtasks.title: Create knowledge base index and search
subtasks.description: Create an index that aggregates all knowledge modules and provides semantic search across troubleshooting content
subtasks.acceptance: Exports searchKnowledge() function that returns relevant troubleshooting entries
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive knowledge base index (672 lines) that aggregates all knowledge modules. Exports searchKnowledge() as main unified search function with relevance scoring, module filtering, and severity filtering. Also provides analyzeLogsComprehensive() for multi-module log analysis, getKnowledgeBaseStats() for statistics, getIssueById() for specific issue lookup, findRelatedIssues() for cross-module issue relationships, and getAllCriticalIssues(). Re-exports all module-specific functions for convenient access. Created comprehensive README.md (360 lines) with usage examples and API documentation. Commit: 0925d99

phases.name: Enhanced Diagnostic Tools
phases.description: Extend agent tools with specialized diagnostic capabilities for common troubleshooting scenarios

subtasks.title: Create VPN connectivity diagnostic tool
subtasks.description: Build tool to diagnose 'VPN healthy but services can't connect' - checks routing, DNS through VPN, port forwarding, and service network attachment
subtasks.acceptance: diagnose_vpn_connectivity() tool returns detailed analysis with specific recommendations
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive VPN connectivity diagnostic tool in diagnosticTools.ts (595 lines). The diagnose_vpn_connectivity() function performs 10 diagnostic steps: (1) Gluetun service health check, (2) Log analysis with pattern matching against VPN_TROUBLESHOOTING_KB, (3) Running diagnostic steps from 'vpn-healthy-but-no-connection' issue pattern, (4) network_mode validation for dependent services (qbittorrent, transmission, deluge, prowlarr), (5) External connectivity test from Gluetun container, (6) DNS resolution test through VPN, (7) Port forwarding configuration check. Returns detailed VpnDiagnosticData with: health status, service info, array of DiagnosticCheck results, matched issue patterns with confidence scores, prioritized recommendations with Solution objects, list of affected services, and summary message. Security: Service name validation with allowlist. Tool metadata exported for orchestration. Follows patterns from agentTools.ts with ToolResult return type and comprehensive error handling. Commit: e6ccb0c

subtasks.title: Create Arr interconnection diagnostic tool
subtasks.description: Build tool to check Arr service connections: validates API keys, tests endpoints, verifies download client settings, and checks import paths
subtasks.acceptance: diagnose_arr_connections() tool identifies broken connections between services
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive Arr interconnection diagnostic tool in diagnosticTools.ts (567 lines of new code). The diagnose_arr_connections() function performs 7 diagnostic steps: (1) Check Arr service status (running/ready), (2) Extract and validate API keys against live services, (3) Test service-to-service connectivity (DNS and HTTP) between all running Arr services, (4) Check download client connectivity and network mode (VPN detection), (5) Analyze logs with pattern matching against ARR_INTERCONNECTION_KB, (6) Generate prioritized recommendations, (7) Determine overall health. Returns detailed ArrDiagnosticData with: health status, per-service status (running, apiKeyValid, reachable, issues), download client status (running, reachable, configured, network mode), array of DiagnosticCheck results, matched issue patterns with confidence scores, prioritized recommendations with Solution objects, configuration issues with severity, and summary message. Security: Service name validation with allowlist. Tool metadata exported for orchestration. Follows patterns from diagnoseVpnConnectivity with ToolResult return type and comprehensive error handling. Imports and uses arrService functions for container management, API key extraction/validation. Detects VPN network mode and adjusts connectivity tests accordingly. Commit: 9ca22a5

subtasks.title: Create media scanner diagnostic tool
subtasks.description: Build tool to diagnose Plex/Jellyfin scanning issues: checks library paths, file permissions, naming conventions, and triggers test scans
subtasks.acceptance: diagnose_media_scanner() tool identifies why media isn't being detected
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive media scanner diagnostic tool in diagnosticTools.ts (575 lines of new code). The diagnoseMediaScanner() function performs 7 diagnostic steps: (1) Check media server status (Plex/Jellyfin/Emby running), (2) Validate PUID/PGID configuration for permissions, (3) Test library path accessibility and scan for media files (mkv, mp4, avi, mov, m4v, wmv, flv), (4) Check file naming conventions (movie year format, TV SxxExx format, special characters), (5) Analyze logs with pattern matching against MEDIA_SCANNING_KB, (6) Generate prioritized recommendations, (7) Determine overall health. Returns detailed MediaScannerDiagnosticData with: health status, per-server status (running, containerName, issues), library paths array (path, accessible, hasMedia, fileCount, issues), permissions data (puid, pgid, configured, issues), naming conventions (checked, sampleFiles, issues), array of DiagnosticCheck results, matched issue patterns with confidence scores, prioritized recommendations with Solution objects, and summary message. Security: Service name validation with allowlist. Tool metadata exported for orchestration. Follows patterns from diagnoseVpnConnectivity and diagnoseArrConnections with ToolResult return type and comprehensive error handling. Imports and uses functions from mediaScanning knowledge module: matchLogPatterns, getIssueById, getScanningIssues, getPermissionIssues. Detects permission issues (PUID/PGID missing), path mount issues (volume not accessible), file naming issues (missing year/episode format), and generates specific recommendations from matched knowledge base patterns (library-not-updating, permission-denied, file-naming-incorrect). Commit: f200d29

subtasks.title: Enhance log analysis with error pattern matching
subtasks.description: Extend analyzeLogs() to match against ERROR_PATTERNS database and return known issues with solutions
subtasks.acceptance: analyze_logs() returns knownIssues array with matched patterns and solutions
subtasks.notes:
Enhanced analyzeLogs() function in agentTools.ts to match log output against ERROR_PATTERNS database. The function now:
- Imports matchErrorPatterns from errorPatterns knowledge module
- Calls matchErrorPatterns(output) on the full log output
- Returns knownIssues array with matched patterns containing: id, title, description, severity, category, causes, fixes, and knowledgeBaseRef
- Provides actionable solutions from the comprehensive ERROR_PATTERNS database (30+ patterns)
- Updated TOOL_METADATA description to reflect new capability
- Added debug logging for diagnostics

The analyze_logs() tool now automatically identifies known error patterns and provides specific solutions, linking back to detailed knowledge base modules for deep troubleshooting. This enables the AI assistant to provide targeted, context-aware troubleshooting guidance based on actual log analysis. Commit: d901654
